description: Get activities. Activities are records of events that happened with MASV resources like packages, links and transfers. Each activity has assosiated events and can be in one of several states: pending, started, complete, cancelled, error. Full list of activity types: package_upload_to_masv (package upload from user or connected storage integration to MASV), package_download_from_masv (user downloads package), link_generation (new download link is added to the package), package_transfer_masv_to_cloud (package transfer from MASV to connected storage integration)

activity_states.description: Retrieve records that has any of the specified activity states

activity_types.description: Retrieve records that has any of the specified activity types. Activities: package_upload_to_masv - package upload from user or connected storage integration to MASV, package_download_from_masv - user downloading package from MASV, link_generation - adding new download link for the package, package_transfer_masv_to_cloud - package transfer to connected storage integration

created_at_end.description: Retrieve records that were created before (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SS)

created_at_start.description: Retrieve records that were created after (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:SS)

limit.description: Number of records returned per page

package_id.description: Retrieve records that belongs to the specified package ID

page.description: Page number of paginated response. First page is 1

portals.description: Retrieve records that belong to any of the specified portal IDs

teamspaces.description: Retrieve records where teamspace id is equal to one of these values

name: get_activities
